## Interfaces

### Changed

```ts
interface Changed {
    readonly path: string;
    readonly added: readonly Line[];
    readonly removed: readonly Line[];
}
```

### Checklist

```ts
interface Checklist {
    /** Globs naming the files that judge code: lock tests, hooks, bands, REVIEW.md, this file. */
    readonly gates: readonly string[];
    readonly items: readonly Item[];
}
```

### Comment

A PR comment as `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<n>/comments` lists it.

```ts
interface Comment {
    readonly body?: string | null;
    /** When it was posted (ISO 8601, UTC), so the author's later replies can be told apart. */
    readonly created_at?: string | null;
}
```

### Compiled

```ts
interface Compiled {
    readonly text: string;
    readonly bytes: number;
    readonly budget: number;
    /** Ids to drop to fit, lowest firing first; empty when it fits. */
    readonly drop: readonly string[];
}
```

### Fired

```ts
interface Fired {
    readonly item: Item;
    readonly at: readonly Hit[];
}
```

### Git

```ts
interface Git {
    /** `git diff --no-renames -U0 <range>`. */
    readonly diff: (range: string) => Promise<string>;
    /** The file at `ref`, as `git show <ref>:<path>` prints it. */
    readonly show: (ref: string, path: string) => Promise<string>;
}
```

### Hit

```ts
interface Hit {
    readonly file: string;
    /** The line in the new file for an added line, in the old file for a removed one; absent for a file-level hit. */
    readonly line?: number;
    readonly side?: 'added' | 'removed';
}
```

### Item

One item: an id, a trigger readable from a diff, and what the reviewer does when it fires.

```ts
interface Item {
    readonly id: string;
    readonly trigger: {
        /** Globs, matched with `path.matchesGlob` against the repo-relative path of a changed file. */
        readonly paths: readonly string[];
        /** A regex tested against each added or removed line of a matching file. Absent: any change fires. */
        readonly pattern?: string | undefined;
    };
    readonly question: string;
    readonly check: string;
    /** The PRs, incidents, decisions or lock tests behind the item: why it exists. */
    readonly sources: readonly string[];
}
```

### Line

What a diff changed, read from `git diff --no-renames -U0` text: each file with the lines it
added (numbered in the new file) and removed (numbered in the old one). A deleted file keeps its
old path, so a trigger on that path still fires when the file goes away, and a binary or
mode-only change is still a changed file, with no lines.

```ts
interface Line {
    readonly line: number;
    readonly text: string;
}
```

### Protection

```ts
interface Protection {
    readonly gates: readonly string[];
    readonly code: readonly string[];
    /** Both kinds changed together. */
    readonly flagged: boolean;
}
```

### Reply

A PR conversation comment or review-thread comment, as `gh api .../issues/<n>/comments` and
`gh api .../pulls/<n>/comments` list them: a reply the author made to the reviewer.

```ts
interface Reply extends Comment {
    readonly user?: {
        readonly login?: string | null;
        readonly type?: string | null;
    } | null;
    /** The file a review-thread comment sits on; absent on a conversation comment. */
    readonly path?: string | null;
    readonly line?: number | null;
}
```
